title: Sample 18-5: Diagramming with Shapes

illustrates.quote: Linear Diagrams with Shapes. Use a transcriber-defined typeform indicator before words enclosed in shapes, e.g., circles, boxes, etc. List the typeform indicators on the Special Symbols page or in a transcriber’s note before the text.

blocks.text: The circled word is the subject, the boxed word is the verb.

Transcriber’s note (back-translated): "Symbols used: [circled-word mark] Circled word [boxed-word mark] Boxed word." followed by two sentences: "1. The boy [mark]boy [mark]played in the park." and "2. [mark]I [mark]walk to school." with "boy"/"I" circled and "played"/"walk" boxed. Not modeled: F-188 (two distinct transcriber-defined marks needed — one for circled, one for boxed — and Emboss can mint none beyond its own single hardcoded asterism symbol).

print.notes: In item 1, 'boy' is circled and 'played' is boxed; in item 2, 'I' is circled and 'walk' is boxed.
